build_hubert_ctc_model: build a HubertCtc model instance using HubertCtc.build_model with config and task
build_hubert_encoder: build a HubertEncoder to extract features from audio source with padding mask
run_hubert_ctc_forward: run the HubertCtc forward pass to get encoder output logits for CTC decoding
get_normalized_probs: get normalized softmax or log softmax probabilities from HubertCtc encoder output
get_logits: get CTC logits from HubertCtc net output with padding mask applied
